cause: a3dDirectSpecular (program/chunks/brdf.glsl.ts) adds a broad multiple-scattering lobe coloured by the mean Fresnel once: (F0 + (F90-F0)/21) * (1-Eo)(1-Ei)/pi. Right for metals, ~25x too much for a 0.04 dielectric, so rough dielectrics gain ~0.025 linear of white under a lone directional light. Not an environment or ambient floor (black albedo with light intensity 0 renders 0).
